records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: borrowed partly from Old French capital and partly from Latin capitālis (in sense “head of cattle”), from caput

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from Latin capitāneus, from Latin caput 'head'

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from Latin capitulum 'a chapter of a book, in Medieval Latin also a synod or council', diminutive of caput 'a head'

note: capital / captain / chapter 均给出 caput 'head'，captain 经古法语 capitaine。 词库外旁证条目（仅印证同一词源，不对应词库词条）：chapter。
